meta.name: azure-kubernetes
meta.description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划、创建并配置生产就绪的 AKS 集群。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正计划在 Azure 上搭建生产级 Kubernetes 集群。
copy.tagline_en: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning to set up production-grade Kubernetes clusters on Azure.

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 根据你对计算、网络、安全等需求,产出一份推荐的 AKS 集群配置方案,并区分创建前难改的 Day-0 决策和创建后可改的 Day-1 功能,操作时借助 Azure MCP 工具或 az aks 命令。
howto.when: 当你提出创建或规划 AKS 集群、设计网络、选择 SKU 等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个生产级 AKS 集群,给出 Day-0 清单。
say.note: 产出配置建议与检查清单。

say.text: AKS 选 Automatic 还是 Standard SKU?
say.note: 根据控制需求与便利性给出选择理由。

say.text: 我的 AKS 用 Azure CNI Overlay 还是 VNet?
say.note: 给出 pod IP 模型建议及理由。

howto.what_en: This skill produces a recommended AKS cluster configuration based on user requirements, distinguishing Day-0 decisions (networking, API server) from Day-1 features. It uses Azure MCP tools or az aks CLI to plan compute, networking, security, observability, upgrades, and cost.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks to create/plan an AKS cluster, design networking, choose SKU, or perform related Day-0/Day-1 tasks.

say_en.text: Plan a production AKS cluster and give me a Day-0 checklist.
say_en.note: Returns a recommended configuration and checklist.

say_en.text: Should I use AKS Automatic or Standard SKU?
say_en.note: Explains the tradeoff based on control vs convenience.

say_en.text: Azure CNI Overlay or VNet-routable for my AKS?
say_en.note: Recommends a pod IP model with rationale.
